description:
How good is the cheapest BRAND NEW 6GB GPU on the market in 2024? Intel ARC A380

Games tested: #cyberpunk2077 #cs2 #forzahorizon5 #valorant #warzone #wukong #fortnite #apex #apexlegends #r6 #tomclancysrainbowsixsiege 

Timestamps:
0:00  Arc A380 Intro
0:43 3DMark Time Spy benchmark
1:28  Call of Duty: Warzone
1:51 CS2
1:59 Forza Horizon 5
2:29 GTA V
3:01 Apex Legends
3:09 Fortnite :(
3:25 Black Myth: Wukong
3:40 Valorant
4:09 Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
4:25 Cyberpunk 2077 + outro

#pc #gaming #pcgaming  #benchmark #gpu #intelarc 

Test system specs:
AMD Ryzen 5 5600
Tower Cooler
G.Skill Aegis 2x8GB (16GB) DDR4 3200MHz
Gigabyte AORUS B550M Elite
ASRock ARC A380 6GB
Western Digital Blue SA510 2TB SATA SSD
fulltitle: Intel’s Arc A380 is full of surprises
